title: Childhood daylight disc sighting

tellings.quote: And um broad daylight, perfectly seamless disc about 1963 probably.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who speaks publicly about UFOs, told a podcast host named Jesse Michels in 2025 about something he says he saw as a boy in Charlotte, North Carolina. He says that around 1963, in broad daylight, he saw a perfectly seamless disc in the sky. He tells it as the first moment of his own lifelong interest, and if true it would mean such craft were around and visible decades ago.
